week.blurb: Sunny and pleasant with a high near 82, once that patchy morning fog burns off by 8.
Mostly sunny and dry for most of Wednesday, then storm chances creep in after dark and really ramp up overnight.
Thursday turns unsettled fast, with showers and thunderstorms likely by afternoon and lingering into the evening.
A cooler, breezier Friday near 76, with lingering shower chances especially before early afternoon.
Sunny and comfortable Saturday, high near 77, a nice reset after the midweek storms.
Mostly sunny Sunday with a high near 79, though clouds and a shower chance build in after dark.
Partly sunny Monday near 79 with a modest shower chance hanging around through the day.
